CommentRules.title: Comment replies
CommentRules.description: Rules that answer, by themselves and in public, the comments under a channel’s posts that hold a keyword you chose: once a comment and once a person, 25 replies a day at most, 100 a day for all of a channel’s rules together, each one of your inbox’s replies. They answer on Mastodon, and on Facebook Pages and Instagram where Peal reads their comments; Bluesky’s, X’s, LinkedIn’s and YouTube’s rules forbid an app to answer by itself. A rule never likes or follows anyone. On Instagram and Facebook Pages, it may also send the author of each comment it answered one private message, after its public reply, where the channel’s direct messages are on.
